Trailing sentence punctuation is not part of the href: see https://example.com/a. Nor is a comma, https://example.com/b, nor a semicolon https://example.com/c; nor a question mark https://example.com/d?

A closing paren that belongs to the sentence is given back (see https://example.com/e), but one the url opened is kept: https://example.com/wiki/Topic_(disambiguation).
